additional_info.subject: ID0447640-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / SD 314070671001] no more OCPP communication CRM:02678000316
additional_info.body:
Hi Gregoire,
If you are able to restart it, please do it, but please keep a record of how many times you have performed this, because, if it keeps happening, then we need to send the Field service team to check why the router is not working as it should.
From my side, it's completely up to you, you can raise a ticket and we can trial the reboot always as a first, and if it's not successfull, we convey the information to the regional team.
As far as the problem looks like, it seems like an internal modem issue, the charger should not go out of order if you do the reboot.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
